name: ranking-claims
title: A ranking makes many claims
idea: A strict ranking of n units makes n(n − 1)/2 claims, and the posterior expects many of them to be wrong.
from: v1 whole · v1 L-10 ranking-claims (with both More boxes as panels)
credit: Firms from Kline, Rose and Walters (2024), ranked here by posterior mean; the school count from the California Department of Education, 2026 California School Dashboard chronic absenteeism data, academic year 2025–26, via postrank 1.1.0 (pr_case_cde); six fictional sites from the postrank tutorial.
caption: Counts and expected counts are computed in this browser from each data set's pair probabilities: the six sites of the postrank tutorial, a simulated league whose posterior is set by hand, and KRW's 97 firms.
